description: This file defines the MigrationHelper class used for managing database migrations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for logging the start and finish of migrations, creating migration log tables, and fetching database schema helpers.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate database migration logging, including starting and finishing migration logs, and creating migration log tables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally accepts a Doctrine DBAL Connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection, either from the stored property or via a static method.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of SchemaHelper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: logMigrationStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a migration process, creating the migration log table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: logMigrationFinished
methods.description: Logs the completion of a migration by updating the relevant record with the finish timestamp.
